scope.statement: The supported historical product window is 2011 through the latest available source date. Years before 2011 are not part of the acquisition or publication plan.

enableWhen: official source rows for the requested period have been imported
neighborhood and offense mappings pass validation
the source row unit is disclosed
known gaps and source transitions are represented in metadata
publicationPolicy.missingDataRule: Missing or rejected observations remain null and are never converted to zero.
publicationPolicy.partialYearRule: A partial year is labeled year-to-date and is not compared with an unmatched full calendar year.

CPD_PDI.title: PDI (Police Data Initiative) Crime Incidents
CPD_PDI.role: historical source for 2011-01-01 through the operational cutoff on 2024-06-02
CPD_PDI.caveat: The dataset contains isolated dates outside the supported window and a small number of records reported after the operational cutoff. Those records do not extend the modeled PDI coverage period.

CPD_STARS.title: Reported Crime (STARS Category Offenses) on or after 6/3/2024

CPD_NEIGHBORHOOD_REPORTS.title: CPD Neighborhood Reports
CPD_NEIGHBORHOOD_REPORTS.role: fresher current layer for map, ranking, comparison, and profile statistics

CITY_PLANNING_2020_SNA_PROFILES.title: 2020 Statistical Neighborhood Approximations
CITY_PLANNING_2020_SNA_PROFILES.role: neighborhood population denominator for violent-crime rates per 1,000

coveragePeriods.note: SNA, CPD-neighborhood, and community-council fields are resolved in that order. Remaining unresolved source rows stay citywide and are not allocated to neighborhoods.

coveragePeriods.sourceLayerNote: CPD neighborhood reports supply the fresher aggregate cutoff; STARS remains the offense-level source through 2026-06-23.

comparisonRules.completedYearToCompletedYear: allowed after both years pass publication validation
comparisonRules.currentYearToHistoricalYear: compare January 1 through the current source cutoff month and day in both years
comparisonRules.currentYearToFiveYearAverage: use only validated years with the same month/day window and disclose excluded years
comparisonRules.crossSystem: PDI incident rows and STARS offense rows are not assumed equivalent; cross-system metrics require an explicit harmonized category definition and a visible transition annotation
comparisonRules.percentChangeWithZeroBaseline: represent as new_activity rather than infinity

qualityGates: source retrieval metadata and query are recorded
every offense label is mapped or reported as unmapped
every neighborhood label is mapped or reported as unmapped
annual and neighborhood totals reconcile with the processed artifact
duplicate and out-of-window records are reported
2024 PDI/STARS transition validation passes or publishes a visible warning
year completeness and data cutoff are exposed to the interface
knownLimitations: The browser artifact publishes calendar-year history for 2011–2025 and comparable January 1–August 22 windows for 2011–2026.
PDI and STARS use different source row units.
Historical observations are displayed on the current 2020 SNA proxy. Unresolved PDI neighborhood rows remain in an explicit citywide unassigned bucket, with the largest gaps in 2011 and 2012.

Published City Planning neighborhood-profile populations do not sum to the direct Citywide profile; neighborhood rates use each published profile and the citywide rate uses the direct Citywide population.
